latest_release.name: v6.0.4
latest_release.body:
# Spree 6.0.4

Spree 6.0.4 is a patch release with a refreshed admin dashboard and seller panel, a richer seller page for marketplace operators, and built-in diagnostics for bug reports. It also fixes a set of checkout completion races, draft order totals, and email lookups in apps that encrypt emails.

```bash
npx spree upgrade
```

---

## ✨ New features

- **Diagnostics and Send feedback.** Settings → System info shows an anonymised report of versions, runtime, infrastructure, changed settings and recent errors, and Send feedback in the account menu opens a bug report with it attached. Developers get View as JSON with Copy as curl on detail pages and a request inspector (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+D). [#15176](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15176)
- **Seller page for operators.** The admin seller page shows the last 30 days of sales and commission, orders still to fulfill and products in review, with the seller's products and orders as full lists. Every section edits in place, including the returns address and holiday mode. [#15177](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15177)
- **Approve sellers without onboarding.** Operators can approve a pending or invited seller directly, for example a seller they set up on a vendor's behalf, by overriding the requirements. [#15187](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15187)
- **Team invitations for active sellers.** Operators can add people to the team of a seller that is already approved. [#15170](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15170)
- **Seller panel settings.** Sellers get Settings → General (contact details, addresses, holiday mode), Profile (what shoppers see) and Taxes, each as one simple form page. The Complete profile step no longer requires a contact email unless the operator turns that on. [#15190](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15190) [#15191](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15191)
- **Stock adjustment reasons.** Bulk stock updates can carry a reason such as received, damaged or count, shown in the stock history. [#15138](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15138)
- **Category and collection events.** Adding a product to, or removing it from, a category or collection publishes an event that webhooks can subscribe to. [#15104](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15104) by @KacperMekarski

## 🧭 Admin dashboard improvements

- **A refreshed look.** The admin dashboard and seller panel use the Inter font, a neutral palette with a near-black dark theme, lighter list tables with a compact density option, and order pages organised into sections. [#15136](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15136)
- **Media library.** A large media dialog with search, filters, upload, grid or list view and sorting, a full-screen media editor, and images picked per variant. Sellers can remove images from their products. [#15136](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15136)
- **New pages and pickers.** Supplier and customer group pages, one customer picker with Add new customer everywhere, adding company members from existing customers, own and seller tabs on stock locations, and out of stock and low stock filters across all locations. [#15136](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15136)
- **Settings pages.** Payments, storefront and store settings have their own pages, and the settings menu sits beside the main navigation. [#15136](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15136)
- **Missing price warning.** An active product warns when shoppers paying in a currency cannot see it because it has no price there. [#15165](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15165)
- **Table search option.** Lists that cannot search by free text no longer show a search box. [#15164](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15164) by @KacperMekarski

- Removing a line from a draft order updates its totals and quantity. [#15179](https://github.com/spree/spree/pull/15179)
